Comment: RT Quality Settings Panel - P3 Phase Demo

This flow demonstrates the RT Quality panel structure once it's wired to a menu item. The panel shows 5 rows (Shadows, AO, GI, Reflections, Ray Resolution) with 2 dropdown columns (Real-time, Export). Each dropdown cycles through quality tiers on click.
To properly test this flow, the RT Quality panel needs to be opened from a menu item (e.g., MANIFOLD ▸ Settings… ▸ RT Quality…), which is a follow-up integration task.
